L105: 【37†Show! Music Core】 Chart winners (2025)
L106: ---
L107: The Show! Music Core Chart is a 【38†record chart】 on the South Korean 【39†MBC】 television music program 【37†Show! Music Core】. Every week, the show awards the best-performing 【40†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast.
L108: Since November 11, 2023, the show has been hosted by 【41†Lee Jung-ha】, 【42†Sullyoon】, and 【43†Younghoon】 until February 15, 2025.^{【44†[1]】} On February 10, 2025, it was announced that 【45†Hearts2Hearts】' A-Na, 【46†TWS】' Dohoon, and 【47†Zerobaseone】's Kim Gyu-vin would host the show starting on March 1, 2025.^{【48†[2]】}
